checks.label: STX vaults walked vs vaults-sorted total-vaults
STX vaults USDA debt: Σ vaults vs vaults-data total-debt
STX collateral: Σ vaults ≤ balance of vaults-pool-active
checks.note: The pool can hold more than the vaults' collateral (surplus from redemptions, fees and direct transfers), so the check is Σ ≤ pool, with the surplus shown.
